title: Kling 3.0 Pro
description: Kuaishou Kling 3.0 in Professional mode (1080p) — text-to-video, plus image-to-video with a start frame and an optional end frame. Any duration from 3 to 15 seconds. Optional generated audio. Billed per second of output: 292 credits per second without audio, 437 with generated audio (POST /v1/cost quotes any request).

aspect_ratio.description: Aspect ratio. Ignored when a start image already sets the frame.

end_image.description: Optional end frame, used together with `image` (the start frame) to interpolate the video between the two frames. Same input forms as `image`.

generate_audio.description: Generate audio with the video. Raises the per-second rate on Standard/Pro (no price impact at 4K) — estimate via POST /v1/cost.

image.description: Optional start frame for image-to-video. Provide a public image URL, a data URI, raw base64, or an uploaded-file URL from POST /v1/uploads. JPG or PNG, at least 300px on each side, aspect ratio between 2:5 and 5:2. Omit for text-to-video.

prompt.description: Text description of the video (up to 2,500 characters).
